rules: Never use a default to overwrite an explicit user fact.
A reference role grants permission only for the assigned visual dimensions.
Identity locks preserve identity but do not block an explicitly selected body-transformation mode.
Strict historical reconstruction may reject an explicit period-incompatible element only by surfacing the conflict; it must not silently replace the user's element.
If the user intentionally requests a hybrid, retain the conflict as an intentional adaptation and label it in the semantic spec.
